title: Contracted Rent of a Like-Program Lease Term Agreement Renewal
content:
The contracted rent of a like-program renewal of a Lease Term Agreement — a renewal into the same term program as the expiring term — is the offered rent of the most recently delivered offer line for the renewing term program on the expiring term, rounded half up to the cent.

## Terms used

- **Offer line for the renewing term program.** A renewal offer line delivered on the expiring term whose offered program is the program being renewed into; lines for other programs on the same term are not read.
- **Most recently delivered.** The line with the latest offer date among those lines.
- **Offered rent.** The monthly rent written on that line.
- **Rounded half up to the cent.** An amount reaching half a cent, or falling short of half a cent by no more than 0.0001 cents, is rounded up to the next cent; any other amount is rounded down.

## Worked case (hypothetical)

An expiring Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term carries three renewal offer lines:

| Line | Offered program | Offer date | Offered rent |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 1 March | 2,210.00 |
| B | Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 1 March | 2,187.90 |
| C | Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 20 March | 2,160.00 |

For a renewal into the Standard Lease (10-12 Months) program, lines A and C are the lines for the renewing program; C is the most recently delivered, so the contracted rent is 2,160.00 dollars. Line B belongs to another program and is not read.
